CDS Protocol H - Cardiovascular

Protocol cds protocol cardiovascular heart

Evidence: Grade C (scientific)

Summary

Cardiovascular-focused CDS protocol for heart support and circulatory conditions.

Indications

  • Cardiovascular support
  • Heart failure support
  • Circulatory conditions
  • Blood pressure support

Steps

  1. Prepare cardiovascular support dose
  2. Follow support protocol
  3. Monitor cardiovascular status
  4. Support with heart-healthy practices
  5. Medical coordination recommended

Dosage

Cardiovascular protocol: 1 ml CDS in 100ml water, 2 times daily

Expected Outcomes

  • Cardiovascular support
  • Circulatory optimization
  • Reduced inflammation
  • Systemic health support

Monitoring

  • Monitor cardiovascular symptoms
  • Watch for blood pressure changes
  • Track heart rate
  • Medical supervision for cardiac conditions

Frequency: 2 times daily

Related Items

Related Ailments

  • Heart Failure
    Cardiovascular condition where the heart cannot pump enough blood to meet the body's needs, often causing fluid buildup and edema.
  • Cardiovascular Disease
    Group of diseases affecting the heart and blood vessels, including coronary artery disease, heart failure, and stroke.
